title: finding(types/components): `AppComponentSchema` declares the node type `app`, but `app` is served by `PageRenderer`, which reads `PageNodeSchema` — one name, two live channels
body:
> ⛔ **本卡此刻在决策箱里(`needs-user-decision`),活的问题**是 [`5715262248`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5715262248) 末尾那四个选项 —— **A1 / A2 / E / C**,回一个字母即可。
> ⛔ 本正文以下的全部内容,包括下面那段 ⭐ 和它的 A/B/C/D 提问,是 `2026-09-12T08:01Z` 立卡与其后各轮的**历史记录**,⛔ 不是当前的提问。
>
> **发生了什么(一句话)。** `2026-09-17T12:20Z` 裁定 letter A;派发前按**裁决自己要求的那次普查**重量,下面那句「本仓今天没有任何文档踩在上面 …… 迁移代价在这个仓里是零」**是假的**(仓内 2 份、姊妹仓 6 份、3 条 live e2e 站在上面),而且上游 `@objectstack/spec` 的 `PageTypeSchema` 把页面种类枚举死为 `record` / `home` / `app` / `utility` / `list` —— **`page` 不是其中之一**,所以裁决要墓碑「指向 `page`」的那句话,指向的是一个上游会拒收的值。五条读数、控制词、以及四棱分析全在 [`5715262248`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5715262248)。
>
> ⚠️ 给未来任何一席:⛔ **不要**因为本卡有一条 letter A 的裁决就派发它。裁决在案,但它建立的那个读数已被同仪器带对照地推翻,重新批准是维护者的事。

---

## 维护者速读

`app` 这个名字在平台上同时是两样东西:一样是**一份应用级文档**(运行器和布局那条路读它),一样是**一个可注册的界面节点**(交给节点渲染器那条路)。两条路都活着,而且各有各的声明,谁都没提过对方。

后果是静默的:一个作者(或 AI)按「应用组件」的类型声明写一个节点、交给节点渲染器,实际接手的是**页面渲染器**,它读的是另一份完全无关的声明。作者写的键被忽略,类型检查是绿的,运行时不报错,界面上只是少了点东西。

⭐ 本席今天补了原卡点名「⛔ 没量过」的两个读数(`origin/main` `88561fdc48`,带对照):

| 读数 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 本仓有没有文档把 `app` 当界面节点写 | **零**。全树只有一处 `"type": "app"`,在 VS Code 扩展那页文档里,而它带 `pages`,是**应用级文档**,属于另一条通道。对照:`"type": "page"` 在示例语料里 6 个文件,所以这个零是读数,⛔ 不是空查询。 |
| 另外四个共用页面渲染器的名字 | `page` 有声明且对得上;`utility` / `home` / `record` 在类型包里**根本没有声明**(带起爆对照:同一查法能在同一目录找出 `page` 与 `app` 的声明)。⇒ 它们是另一种缺陷(注册了但没声明,objectui#8499 那个方向),⛔ 不是本卡这一种。 |

⇒ **只有 `app` 一个名字是「声明与注册互相矛盾」**,而本仓今天没有任何文档踩在上面。原卡担心的迁移代价,在这个仓里是零 —— 仓外的客户应用我看不见。

> ⛔ **以上这一段已被推翻,留作记录。** 「本仓今天没有任何文档踩在上面」与「迁移代价在这个仓里是零」两句,在 `origin/main` `29a8a95261ce` / `30be2ac0bb21` 上带发火对照重量为:仓内 **2** 份组件夹具直接把 `type: 'app'` 喂给渲染器,姊妹仓 objectstack 的 showcase 有 **6** 份 kind 为 `app` 的存储页面,**3** 条 live e2e 加载其中一份。读数与控制词见 [`5715262248`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5715262248)。

四个选择:

- **A —— 让 `app` 不再是界面节点的名字**(改名,或者干脆取消这个注册:页面形状的节点已经有 `page` 这个名字了)。一个名字一个意思,应用级文档那条路不受影响。代价是动一个已发布的节点类型名;⭐ 按上面的读数,本仓迁移面为零。
- **B —— 给 `app` 配它自己的渲染器**,由「应用组件」的声明来定。声明与实现对齐;代价是为一个今天故意复用页面渲染器的名字新增一个渲染器,而没有任何人要求过这个功能。
- **C —— 把这个碰撞正式声明出来**:两边都留,加一道门禁断言「注册名的声明方就是服务它的渲染器」,并把这五个名字记为在册例外。代价是把现状固化成契约,并且从此要养这道门禁和这张例外名单。
- **D —— 先补测量再裁**:原卡要的两个读数里,本仓那一半今天已经补完(见上表),剩下的是仓外的客户应用 —— 而那个数 ⛔ 本席量不到,只能由你判断它是不是零。

我的建议是 **A**(回退:**C**)。**B 我不推荐** —— 要不要「应用组件」这个界面节点是产品决定,不是契约整理。

选哪个:A / B / C / D?

os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:A 让一个名字只剩一个意思,不留任何例外;C 把例外写进契约,还要额外养一道门禁和一张名单;B 新增一整个渲染器面。这一轴上 A 最省,C 最贵。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天本仓零文档踩在上面(实测,带对照),所以没有客户正在疼;拉动来自声明面本身 —— 它是作者和 AI 的说明书,而这本说明书在这一条上给的是错的答案。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:今天是**静默**的那一类 —— AI 按声明写节点,类型检查绿,渲染出来的是另一份声明的结果,它写的键被安静忽略,没有任何人会看见这个错。A 让这个错写不出来(名字不存在了);C 让它继续可能,只是有了在册记录;B 让它变成正确。只有 A 把错误挡在写的时候。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 是一次删除;C 新增一道门禁加一张永久例外名单;B 新增一个永久维护的渲染器。remove 优于 declare-and-maintain,这一轴指向 A。
- 推荐:**A**(回退:**C**)。
- 本分析看不见什么:我看不见这个仓之外的客户应用与已发布文档里有没有人把 `app` 当界面节点写 —— 只要这个数不是零,A 就从「零迁移」变成一次破坏性改名,答案会翻向 C;我也看不见当初把 `app` 注册到页面渲染器上是随手为之还是有意的产品安排(代码里只写了一个 `App Page` 标签,没有出处)。

---

## Re-measured 2026-09-15T07:55Z by the `domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat — the two readings the card flagged as missing

On `origin/main` at `88561fdc48`.

### ① The deciding measurement the card named: is anything authoring `app` as an SDUI node?

The card states the deciding measurement is missing: *"is any real document authoring `{ type: 'app' }` as an SDUI registry node today, as opposed to as a runner/layout app document?"*

- The JSON spelling occurs in **exactly one file** in the whole tree: `content/docs/utilities/vscode-extension.mdx`, once as prose (*"Any `.json` file with `"type": "app"` or component types"*) and once as a fenced example.
- ⚠️ That example is **not** an SDUI node. It is `{ "type": "app", "title": …, "pages": [ … ] }` — an app-level document carrying `pages`, i.e. the runner/layout channel. ⇒ it is an instance of the *other* half of the card's "one name, two channels", not of the collision.
- **Firing control, same instrument:** `"type": "page"` resolves **6** example files under `examples/`. The zero is a reading, ⛔ not a dead query.
- **Absent-token control:** `tzkw_absent_ctl_20260915b` → **0 files** on the same tree (single use — publishing it spends it).

⇒ **inside this repository, zero documents author `app` as an SDUI registry node.** ⛔ Scope: this repository's tree only. Customer applications, published examples and stored metadata outside it were not enumerated and cannot be from this seat.

### ② The card's explicit NOT MEASURED: the other four names

The card records that whether `utility` / `home` / `record` also have competing declarations was ⛔ not measured, and that a repair round must enumerate all five. Enumerated now, in `packages/types/src`:

| registered name | declaration in the types package | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `page` | declared (the page node shape) | registration and declaration **agree** |
| `app` | declared (the app component shape) | **they disagree** — this card |
| `utility` | **none** | registered, undeclared |
| `home` | **none** | registered, undeclared |
| `record` | **none** | registered, undeclared |

**Firing control:** the same query shape, in the same directory, resolves the `page` and `app` type literals. The three zeros are readings, ⛔ not a dead query. (Occurrences of those three words elsewhere in `packages/app-shell` are other vocabularies — modal targets, view names — ⛔ not node-type declarations, which is why the query was scoped to the types package.)

⇒ the five names split **three** ways, not two: one agreeing pair, one disagreeing pair, and three registered-but-undeclared names. ⚠️ Those last three are the objectui#8499 direction (registered with no declared arm), and #8499's PR already measured **505** registered keys with no arm — so they are almost certainly inside that count. ⛔ No new card filed for them: recorded here, and dedup says they belong to #8499's population, not to a fresh one.

---

Measured by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9256 (PR objectui#9261) while extending objectui#8284's compiler-API read-site instrument, and **re-measured and narrowed by the `domain:ui` PM seat before filing** — the seat could not file it itself because both dedup channels were down (REST `/search/*` refused by the egress proxy; MCP `search_issues` rate-limited on the MCP server's own identity). Dedup was run here instead by **enumerating all 452 open issues** (complete: 464 items = 100+100+100+100+64, page 6 empty, matching `open_issues_count`); nothing matches.

⛔ Filed as a `finding` only. Grading is the triage seat's.

## The defect

`AppComponentSchema` declares the component `type` literal `'app'`:

- `packages/types/src/app.ts:369-370` — `export interface AppComponentSchema extends BaseSchema { type: 'app'; … }`
- `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts:377-378` — the mirror, `type: z.literal('app')`

But the registry name `'app'` is served by a renderer declared by a **different** schema:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:693` — `ComponentRegistry.register('app', PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, label: 'App Page' })`
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:475-476` — `export const PageRenderer: React.FC<{ schema: PageNodeSchema; … }>`
- `packages/types/src/layout.ts:747-748` — `export interface PageNodeSchema extends BaseSchema { type: 'page'; … }`

⇒ an author who type-checks a node against `AppComponentSchema` and hands it to `SchemaRenderer` is authoring keys for `PageRenderer`, which reads `PageNodeSchema`. The two declarations are unrelated, and nothing in either one says so.

## ⭐ The real shape: one name, two channels

`AppComponentSchema` is **not** dead — it is read structurally on a different path entirely:

| consumer | line |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/runner/src/App.tsx` | `:16` import, `:81` `useState<AppComponentSchema \| null>` |
| `packages/runner/src/LayoutRenderer.tsx` | `:10` import, `:38` `app: AppComponentSchema` |
| `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` | `:38` import, `:82` `schema: AppComponentSchema` |

⇒ `'app'` means **an app-level document** to the runner/layout path and **an SDUI registry node** to `SchemaRenderer`. Both are live. The hazard is the collision between the two channels, not a dangling declaration — which is why "retire one of them" is very likely the wrong repair.

## ⚠️ The blast radius is larger than one name

`PageRenderer` is registered under **five** names, all reading `PageNodeSchema`:

```
page.tsx:692  register('page',    PageRenderer, pageMeta)
page.tsx:693  register('app',     PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, label: 'App Page' })
page.tsx:694  register('utility', PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, label: 'Utility Page' })
page.tsx:695  register('home',    PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, label: 'Home Page' })
page.tsx:696  register('record',  PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta, label: 'Record Page' })
```

⛔ **`'app'` is the only one measured here.** Whether `utility` / `home` / `record` also have competing declarations is **NOT MEASURED** — a repair round has to enumerate all five, not assume the other four are clean because this one was reported.

## ⚠️ Correction to the source report — the second example does NOT hold

The delivering seat reported a second instance: *"`DetailViewSchema` declares `detail-view`, and that name is registered in plugin-detail with an `any`-typed renderer while `DetailViewSchema` itself is the declaration of the `detail` registration."*

**Re-measured, that one is false and is not part of this card:**

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx:284` registers `'detail-view'` → `DetailViewRenderer`
- `:241` — `export const DetailViewRenderer: React.FC<{ … }>`, **not** `any`
- `:275` — the wrapper renders `<DetailView schema={bound as DetailViewSchema} … />`, i.e. it casts to **`DetailViewSchema`** explicitly

⇒ for `detail-view` the declaration and the registration **agree**. The comment at `:280-283` states the design on purpose: the wrapper is registered rather than the raw component so context wiring works, while `DetailView` stays exported for direct React callers. Nothing to repair there.

## What a repair has to decide

⛔ Not obvious and should not be guessed — this is a naming/ownership ruling, not a mechanical narrowing:

1. **Rename the registry node** so the SDUI name for a page-shaped node is never `app`. Cost: a published node-type name, and every document authoring `type: 'app'` as an SDUI node.
2. **Give `'app'` its own renderer** declared by `AppComponentSchema`. Cost: a new renderer for a name that today deliberately reuses `PageRenderer`.
3. **Declare the collision** — keep both, and add a gate asserting that a registered name's declaring schema is the one whose renderer serves it, with these five as recorded exceptions.

The measurement that should decide it is missing: **is any real document authoring `{ type: 'app' }` as an SDUI registry node today**, as opposed to as a runner/layout app document? Until that is enumerated (not counted), option 1's cost is unknown.
